about: Where a whole ${subject.isM2M} in requestAttributes fails. In round 37 (r37open-ra-is-m2m) the upload was taken and each request answered 400 without calling the PIP, but every request of that case read the GENERAL first. A GENERAL is called when a condition reads it (round 11), and the call prepares its requestAttributes, so the specification expects a request that does not reach the GENERAL to answer as if it were not there, and a filter that reads it to answer 400.

cases.about: Control: a DENY rule over a resource attribute that does not hold. True unless the stand answers every check with 400.

requestAttributes.x is ${subject.isM2M}, and the condition reads subject.parityR38M2mNotRead second. With a = y the first operand decides: the PIP is not called, and the request is true if the failure comes with the call; 400 if a condition that names the PIP fails before it is evaluated. With a = n the condition reads the PIP and answers 400, as r37open-ra-is-m2m did. pipCalls records whether a = y called it.

requestAttributes.x is ${subject.isM2M}, and the rsqlPredicate of the simplified policy reads ${subject.parityR38M2mFilter}. The filter answers 400 if the failure fails the whole answer, as a check does; DENY if the filter reads it as a failed PIP, as it reads a PIP that answers 500. pipCalls records whether the PIP was called.
